provider_receipt.summary: Unsupported completion: the execute receipt does not demonstrate that both registered project authorities were inspected in order or that receipt-backed joined acceptance occurred. Its attempted reads of data/workbench/projects.json and core/projects/tasks/queue.jsonl target files absent from this bound project, and no authority registration, authority-specific findings, or ordered inspection result appears elsewhere in the project-local source evidence. The prior verification receipt does cover the declared clean-tree check and records cargo test exit 0, but those checks cannot establish the missing authority-inspection evidence. Independent source review also found a security-relevant trust-boundary weakness: src/main.rs:35-50 accepts both policy metadata and invocation data from caller-selected files, while src/policy.rs:49-50 trusts the supplied risk, mutation, review, idempotency, and allowed-target declarations; without an authenticated metadata adapter, a caller can self-declare a low-risk read-only tool with allowed_targets ["*"] and obtain allow. No files were modified.
